note: Both sets contain duplicates and vague entities, but Set B correctly binds LUVOIR-A's four science instruments to LUVOIR-A, whereas Set A misbinds that fact to a garbled 'n-axis telescope' and adds two unsupported 'axis telescope' instrument-count claims plus a vague 'baseline mission spacecraft' claim. Set A also misstates the Lynx 10 m focal length as a mirror 'dimension'/'size' twice (Set B does this once) and includes a truncated quote ('52 m starsha'). Set B's remaining weaknesses are the same misbound 10 m dimension, one garbled 'n-axis telescope' claim, and a vague 'spacecraft' instrument count, so it is the more faithful set overall.
